Voucher.description: Amounts are exact integral decimal values. Lexical integer vs 1.0/1e0 is additionally enforced at HTTP ingress. LocalDateTime carries no offset.

id.description: PostgreSQL BIGINT serialized as JSON number; JavaScript safe-integer limit applies.

startAt.description: LocalDateTime, no offset/Z; seconds and up to 6 fractional digits.

endAt.description: LocalDateTime, no offset/Z; seconds and up to 6 fractional digits.

fullName.description: Trimmed on binding, nonblank, max 150 Java UTF-16 code units at runtime; JSON Schema length counts code points.

email.description: Trimmed and normalized to lowercase on binding; validated as email and limited to 150 Java UTF-16 code units at runtime.

phone.description: Trimmed on binding, nonblank, max 20 Java UTF-16 code units at runtime.

password.description: Nonblank; configured Unicode code-point minimum; maximum 72 UTF-8 bytes for BCrypt. Byte and code-point rules are runtime validation.

RegisterRequest.description: Unknown properties are rejected. Auth String-setter DTOs do not have a duplicate-member guard; duplicate handling is not global.

email.description: Trimmed and normalized to lowercase on binding; validated as email and limited to 150 Java UTF-16 code units at runtime.

password.description: Nonblank; maximum 72 UTF-8 bytes for BCrypt. Runtime password policy validates bytes.

LoginRequest.description: Unknown properties are rejected. Auth String-setter DTOs do not have a duplicate-member guard; duplicate handling is not global.

fullName.description: Nonblank after runtime strip; 150 UTF-16 code units at runtime.

dateOfBirth.description: LocalDate; null clears. Future dates are rejected using the configured Clock.

address.description: Null clears; empty/whitespace-only runtime input normalizes to null. 300 UTF-16 code units after strip at runtime.

ProfilePatch.description: Omitted fields are unchanged. fullName must be non-null/nonblank when present. dateOfBirth and address accept null to clear. Runtime strips text before validation; fullName/address limits use Java String.length() UTF-16 code units after strip, while JSON Schema maxLength counts Unicode code points and cannot model strip semantics exactly. Future dateOfBirth is rejected using the configured Clock.

reason.description: Nonblank after strip; actual maximum comes from app.customer.status-reason-max-length (default 500).

CustomerStatus.description: Both status and reason are required. reason must be nonblank; max length defaults to 500 and is configurable. The reason is validated but is not stored in a durable history column. ADMIN self-lock and locking the last ACTIVE ADMIN are rejected.

DocumentUpload.description: Multipart submission. docType, docNumber and frontImage are required. DRIVER_LICENSE also requires a nonblank licenseClass at submission. Other metadata/backImage may be omitted to create PENDING; U-13 approval has additional metadata/image/expiry prerequisites. Image limits default to 5 MiB/file and 11 MiB/request.

docNumber.description: Required nonblank text; runtime strips then applies its 50 UTF-16 code-unit limit.

fullNameOnDoc.description: Optional at submission; runtime strips blank text to null. Required for approval under U-13.

dateOfBirthOnDoc.description: Optional at submission; required for approval under U-13 and checked against Clock.

issuePlace.description: Optional at submission; runtime strips blank text to null. Required for approval under U-13.

issueDate.description: Optional at submission; required for approval under U-13.

expiresAt.description: Optional at submission; required for DRIVER_LICENSE approval; identity-document expiry may be null.

licenseClass.description: Required nonblank at DRIVER_LICENSE submission and approval; optional for other types.

rejectReason.description: Null/omitted for APPROVED; nonblank and bounded for REJECTED.

DocumentReviewRequest.description: APPROVED accepts rejectReason only when omitted or null. REJECTED requires a nonblank reason within the configured bound (default 500); reason is persisted for the reviewed document.

reason.description: For ACTIVE: omitted or null only. For SUSPENDED: required, nonblank, max configured length (default 500).

DriverStatusRequest.description: PENDING is not a command target. ACTIVE accepts omitted or null reason only; SUSPENDED requires a nonblank reason. Reason is validated and discarded, not persisted.

bankName.description: Nonblank after strip; at most 100 Unicode code points at runtime.

accountNumber.description: Nonblank after strip; at most 30 Unicode code points at runtime.

accountHolder.description: Nonblank after strip; at most 150 Unicode code points at runtime.

BankAccountRequest.description: Required payee text is stripped, nonblank and bounded by Unicode code points at runtime; omitted makeDefault defaults to false. The schema maxLength counts raw code points and cannot model the preceding strip step.

VoucherCreate.description: Three NUMERIC(14,0) amount values must be mathematically integral and within range; JSON Schema uses multipleOf: 1, so amount tokens 1.0 and 1e0 remain valid. usageLimit/perUserLimit require lexical JSON integer tokens at runtime; JSON Schema integer describes mathematical integrality and cannot distinguish 1 from 1.0/1e0. PERCENT discountValue is at most 100. Duplicate-member rejection is implemented by this command DTO/parser; object schema alone cannot express duplicate JSON names.

code.description: Required nonblank code; runtime strips, preserves case, rejects controls and limits to 50 Unicode code points.

description.description: Optional/null; runtime strips and blank becomes null, maximum 300 Unicode code points.

startAt.description: Strict LocalDateTime: no offset/Z, 0–6 fractional digits, year 0001–9999; endAt must be later.

endAt.description: Strict LocalDateTime: no offset/Z, 0–6 fractional digits, year 0001–9999; must be later than startAt.

usageLimit.description: Optional/null or positive 32-bit integer token; fractional/exponent tokens are rejected by runtime.

perUserLimit.description: Defaults to 1; positive 32-bit integer token required when supplied.

usageLimit.description: Null means no overall quota; positive integer JSON token otherwise.

VoucherUpdate.description: Both fields are required for PUT. description is nullable; usageLimit is null or a positive 32-bit integer token.
